items.title: Rudy Van Gelder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...at that time I knew Larry Elgart who had a band...

ctx.x: Yeah, there were recording for RCA as a studio location. So, also at that time I knew Larry Elgart who had a band, a working band. Some of the musicians who played for Larry were on that session. Trumpet players, beautiful sounding trumpet players. Rather than talk about it, I wish you could hear it. I have a copy. So they asked me if I wanted to come into the session. So I went there, and this was for a couple of days.
